title: 06b-A T1: composeArcSummary core function + happy-path test
description:
Objective:
Add the new core module that authors an arc summary by calling a ModelClient with a chronological list of SessionRecapRecord. Cover the happy path with two tests: (a) the function returns the model's text verbatim, (b) the user message rendered to the model contains each session id, recap text, and any stateDelta entries.

Files:
- Create: packages/core/src/memory/arcSummary.ts
- Create: packages/core/test/arcSummary.test.ts
- Modify: packages/core/src/index.ts (re-export composeArcSummary and ComposeArcSummaryInput)

Steps:
1. Create packages/core/test/arcSummary.test.ts with the two happy-path tests (see Design field for exact code). Imports come from '../src/index.js'.
2. Run: npx vitest run packages/core/test/arcSummary.test.ts --reporter=verbose
   Expected: FAIL — `composeArcSummary` not exported from '@loreweaver/core' (module not found).
3. Create packages/core/src/memory/arcSummary.ts with the implementation in the Design field.
4. Add the re-export to packages/core/src/index.ts:
     export { composeArcSummary } from './memory/arcSummary.js';
     export type { ComposeArcSummaryInput } from './memory/arcSummary.js';
   Place next to the existing composeSessionRecap re-export (around line 58).
5. Run the same vitest command.
   Expected: 2 tests PASS.
6. Run: npm run typecheck
   Expected: success.
7. Commit:
     git add packages/core/src/memory/arcSummary.ts packages/core/test/arcSummary.test.ts packages/core/src/index.ts
     git commit -m "Add composeArcSummary core function with happy-path tests (loreweaver-4ua)"
acceptance_criteria:
1. packages/core/src/memory/arcSummary.ts exists and exports composeArcSummary plus ComposeArcSummaryInput.
2. packages/core/src/index.ts re-exports both.
3. packages/core/test/arcSummary.test.ts contains the two happy-path tests; both pass.
4. npm run typecheck succeeds.
5. The commit message references loreweaver-4ua.
